name: financetracker-android
description: FinanceTracker Android App - Expense, Debt & Investment Analyzer

scripts.setup: npm install && npx cap init FinanceTracker com.financetracker.android --web-dir www || true && npx cap add android && npm run build:qa && echo '✅ Setup complete! Run: npm run deploy:qa && npm run cap:open'
scripts.cap:init: npx cap init FinanceTracker com.financetracker.android --web-dir www
scripts.deploy:qa: npm run build:qa && npm run cap:sync
scripts.deploy:uat: npm run build:uat && npm run cap:sync

author: FinanceTracker Team
